abstract: A case of right sided abdominal lump with pain in a 45 years female was presented. Radiological investigation revealed a multiloculated cystic mass with a few mural nodules arising from right ovary. The tumor was removed by exploratory laparotomy and histopathological examination showed coexistence of dermoid cyst with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma in the same ovary. Left ovary and uterus was healthy and there was no tumor extension or omental deposits. Postoperative period was uneventful.
abstract_ja: 右側腹部の腹痛と腫瘤を主訴に45歳女性が来院した。画像検査で右卵巣由来の、壁在結節を伴う多房性嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた。開腹による探索的手術で腫瘍を摘出し、病理組織学的検査では同一卵巣内に類皮嚢腫と粘液性嚢胞腺癌の共存が認められた。左卵巣および子宮に異常はなく、腫瘍の進展や大網播種は認めなかった。術後経過は順調であった。
